ShowText2.SourceString: 限定弧盘「预备备」概率提升!
ShowText2.LocalizedString: Limited Arc Ready-Ready Drop Rate Up!

ProbDesc.SourceString: S级弧盘<Orange>「预备备」</>概率提升！占S级弧盘基础概率的25%
ProbDesc.LocalizedString: S-Class Arc <Orange>Ready-Ready</> Drop Rate Up! Takes up 25% of the base S-Class Arc chance.

RuleDesc1.SourceString:
1. <Orange>「猛虎特刊」</>研募计划限时开启！消耗三重钥匙参与本期弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
2. 活动期间，限定S级弧盘<Orange>「预备备」</>的获取概率将大幅提升！
3. 本期「弧盘研募计划」的研募类型为<Orange>「限定特刊」</>，开启1次「限定特刊」共计可获得10个任意品质的弧盘奖励。
4. 所有「限定特刊」中获取弧盘的保底次数完全共享。
RuleDesc1.LocalizedString:
1. <Orange>Tiger Special</> Research Program now available for a limited time! Spend Tri-Keys to participate in this Arc Research Program and obtain current rewards.
2. During the event, the drop rate for limited S-Class Arc <Orange>Ready-Ready</> will be greatly increased!
3. This Arc Research Program features <Orange>Limited Issue</> pulls. Opening 1 Limited Issue grants a total of 10 Arc rewards of any quality.
4. The pity counter for obtaining Arcs is fully shared across all Limited Issues.

RuleDesc2.SourceString:
<Black>【S级弧盘】</>
在本期弧盘研募计划中，每获得1个弧盘时，其为S级弧盘的基础概率为<Orange>3.0000%</>，综合概率（含保底）为<Orange>4.1900%</>（其中，限定S级弧盘为<Orange>1.6800%</>），至多<Orange>6</>次研募必定能通过保底获得S级弧盘，至多<Orange>8</>次研募必能通过保底获取当期限定S级弧盘「预备备」。该研募保底次数将永久累计并可以继承至其他「限定特刊」中。
<Black>【A级弧盘】</>
在本期弧盘研募计划中，每获得1个弧盘时，其为A级弧盘的基础概率为<Orange>7.0000%</>，综合概率（含保底）为<Orange>13.4700%</>，至多1次研募必能通过保底获得A级或以上弧盘。
<Black>【B级弧盘】</>
在本期弧盘研募计划中，每获得1个弧盘时，其为B级弧盘的基础概率为<Orange>90.0000%</>，综合概率（含保底）为<Orange>82.3400%</>。
RuleDesc2.LocalizedString:
<Black>S-Class Arc</>
In this Arc Research Program, each Arc obtained has a base chance of <Orange>3.0000%</> to be an S-Class Arc. The overall drop rate (including pity) is <Orange>4.1900%</>, of which the limited S-Class Arc accounts for <Orange>1.6800%</>. At most <Orange>6</> pulls guarantee an S-Class Arc through pity, at most <Orange>8</> pulls guarantee the current limited S-Class Arc Ready-Ready through pity. This pull pity counter will accumulate permanently and can be inherited in different Limited Issues.
<Black>A-Class Arc</>
In this Arc Research Program, each Arc obtained has a base chance of <Orange>7.0000%</> to be an A-Class Arc. The overall drop rate (including pity) is <Orange>13.4700%</>. At most 1 pull guarantees an A-Class or higher Arc through pity.
<Black>B-Class Arc</>
In this Arc Research Program, each Arc obtained has a base chance of <Orange>90.0000%</> to be a B-Class Arc. The overall drop rate (including pity) is <Orange>82.3400%</>.

ProbDesc.SourceString: S级弧盘<Orange>「预备备」</>概率提升！占S级弧盘基础概率的25%
ProbDesc.LocalizedString: S-Class Arc <Orange>Ready-Ready</> Drop Rate Up! Takes up 25% of the base S-Class Arc chance.

RuleDesc1.SourceString:
1. <Orange>「猛虎特刊」</>研募计划限时开启！消耗三重钥匙参与本期弧盘研募计划并获取当期计划奖励。
2. 活动期间，限定S级弧盘<Orange>「预备备」</>的获取概率将大幅提升！
3. 本期「弧盘研募计划」的研募类型为<Orange>「限定特刊」</>，开启1次「限定特刊」共计可获得10个任意品质的弧盘奖励。
4. 所有「限定特刊」中获取弧盘的保底次数完全共享。
RuleDesc1.LocalizedString:
1. <Orange>Tiger Special</> Research Program now available for a limited time! Spend Tri-Keys to participate in this Arc Research Program and obtain current rewards.
2. During the event, the drop rate for limited S-Class Arc <Orange>Ready-Ready</> will be greatly increased!
3. This Arc Research Program features <Orange>Limited Issue</> pulls. Opening 1 Limited Issue grants a total of 10 Arc rewards of any quality.
4. The pity counter for obtaining Arcs is fully shared across all Limited Issues.

RuleDesc2.SourceString:
<Black>【S级弧盘】</>
在本期弧盘研募计划中，每获得1个弧盘时，其为S级弧盘的基础概率为<Orange>3.0000%</>，综合概率（含保底）为<Orange>4.1900%</>（其中，限定S级弧盘为<Orange>1.6800%</>），至多<Orange>6</>次研募必定能通过保底获得S级弧盘，至多<Orange>8</>次研募必能通过保底获取当期限定S级弧盘「预备备」。该研募保底次数将永久累计并可以继承至其他「限定特刊」中。
<Black>【A级弧盘】</>
在本期弧盘研募计划中，每获得1个弧盘时，其为A级弧盘的基础概率为<Orange>7.0000%</>，综合概率（含保底）为<Orange>13.4700%</>，至多1次研募必能通过保底获得A级或以上弧盘。
<Black>【B级弧盘】</>
在本期弧盘研募计划中，每获得1个弧盘时，其为B级弧盘的基础概率为<Orange>90.0000%</>，综合概率（含保底）为<Orange>82.3400%</>。
RuleDesc2.LocalizedString:
<Black>S-Class Arc</>
In this Arc Research Program, each Arc obtained has a base chance of <Orange>3.0000%</> to be an S-Class Arc. The overall drop rate (including pity) is <Orange>4.1900%</>, of which the limited S-Class Arc accounts for <Orange>1.6800%</>. At most <Orange>6</> pulls guarantee an S-Class Arc through pity, at most <Orange>8</> pulls guarantee the current limited S-Class Arc Ready-Ready through pity. This pull pity counter will accumulate permanently and can be inherited in different Limited Issues.
<Black>A-Class Arc</>
In this Arc Research Program, each Arc obtained has a base chance of <Orange>7.0000%</> to be an A-Class Arc. The overall drop rate (including pity) is <Orange>13.4700%</>. At most 1 pull guarantees an A-Class or higher Arc through pity.
<Black>B-Class Arc</>
In this Arc Research Program, each Arc obtained has a base chance of <Orange>90.0000%</> to be a B-Class Arc. The overall drop rate (including pity) is <Orange>82.3400%</>.
